_comment: Snoopy's checklists, condensed from Apollo 11's (data/missions/apollo_11/lm_checklists.json) for Apollo 10's flight: DOI to 8 nmi over the landing site and no landing, the phasing burn on the PAD's throttle schedule, staging in orbit, the insertion on the ascent engine and the landing mission's rendezvous [adapted for this simulator]. Keys as in checklists.json: V/N/Enter = VERB/NOUN/ENTR, Space = PRO; the switches are on Snoopy's HUD and in its cabin, and the PAD buttons on the HUD and the wrist menu. control: the cabin control a step is done on (an id in data/cockpit/lm_controls.csv); without it the checklist highlight finds the control that writes the step's check channel. phases: the flight phases (mission.phase) a checklist is for; it opens as the commander boards in one. LGC MODE FREE between burns.

steps.text: Charlie Brown: CMC MODE - FREE, then UNDOCK on GO for undocking
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to DOI
Mission Control: the DOI PAD (UPLINK ACTY), or DOI to ask for it
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
Houston: GO for DOI
LGC MODE - AUTO
V37E 40E - P40 DPS Thrusting, TIG-15 min
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to burn attitude
ENG ARM - DES
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on
Monitor V16N40 (TFI, VG, DV) - DPS cutoff
ENG ARM - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to the low pass

checklists.title: The low pass, phasing and staging (P30 / P40)

steps.text: The low pass: 8 nmi over site 2, the landing radar and the photographs; LGC MODE stays FREE
Mission Control: the phasing PAD (UPLINK ACTY)
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
Houston: GO for phasing
LGC MODE - AUTO
V37E 40E - P40 DPS Thrusting, TIG-15 min
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to burn attitude
ENG ARM - DES
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on; 10 % for 26 s, then full thrust
Monitor V16N40 (TFI, VG, DV) - DPS cutoff
ENG ARM - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift through the dwell orbit
Mission Control: the insertion PAD (UPLINK ACTY)
Mission Control: Snoopy's state vector (UPLINK ACTY)
Houston: GO for staging
Ten minutes before the insertion: ABORT STAGE, the descent stage left in orbit

checklists.title: Insertion and rendezvous (P42, P20, P32 to P35)

steps.text: V37E 30E - P30: the insertion PAD
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO
V37E 42E - P42 APS Thrusting
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to burn attitude
ENG ARM - ASC
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on
Monitor V16N40 - APS cutoff: the insertion, about 46 by 11 nmi
ENG ARM - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to CSI
Mission Control: the CSI PAD and Charlie Brown's state vector (UPLINK ACTY)
V37E 20E - P20 Rendezvous navigation: radar marks (V16N54)
V37E 32E - P32 CSI, TIG-25 min: PRO on N11, N55 and N37; check N75, PRO; N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting, TIG-10 min
V50N18: PRO to maneuver; at TIG-5 s V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to CDH
V37E 33E - P33 CDH, TIG-20 min: PRO on N13; check N75, PRO; N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting, TIG-10 min
V50N18: PRO to maneuver; at TIG-5 s V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to TPI
V37E 34E - P34 TPI, TIG-30 min: PRO on N55; check N37, PRO; N58, PRO; N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting, TIG-10 min
V50N18: PRO to maneuver; at TIG-5 s V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to the first midcourse
V37E 35E - P35 first midcourse, 5 min ahead: check N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41; V50N18 PRO; V99N40 PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to the second midcourse
V37E 35E - P35 second midcourse, 5 min ahead: check N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41; V50N18 PRO; V99N40 PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO; LGC MODE stays AUTO for the braking
Braking by the gates on the TTCA: stop 40 m from Charlie Brown
Face Charlie Brown with Snoopy's +X; L: Charlie Brown docks
